# Mindhaven

> Private, person-centred counselling for adults with Erika Martin, MNCPS Accredited. In person in Dalkeith, near Edinburgh, and online across the UK.

## About

Mindhaven is the private counselling practice of Erika Martin, an MNCPS Accredited integrative person-centred counsellor. She works one-to-one with adults of all ages, including people over 65, in person at Mysa Therapy Rooms in Dalkeith (near Edinburgh) and online across the UK.

## Practitioner

- **Name:** Erika Martin
- **Credentials:** Accredited Member of the National Counselling and Psychotherapy Society (MNCPS Acc.)
- **PSA:** The NCPS register is accredited by the Professional Standards Authority
- **Training:** Advanced Diploma in Psychotherapeutic Counselling (Ad Dip PC), Chrysalis Ltd, November 2018. Modules include the humanistic and psychodynamic approaches, CBT and integration, stress and anxiety, relationships, bereavement and loss, and understanding depression.
- **NCPS register listing:** https://www.search-ncps.com/search/FindaTherapist/NCS16-03808
- **Facebook:** https://www.facebook.com/ErikaMartinCounselling
- **LinkedIn:** https://www.linkedin.com/in/erika-martin-counselling

## Therapeutic Approach

Erika is an integrative person-centred counsellor. The client sets the pace, within a warm and non-judgemental relationship. She also uses the psychodynamic approach and is familiar with Cognitive Behavioural Therapy techniques.

## Areas of Work

- Anxiety and worry
- Bereavement and loss
- Low mood
- Relationship difficulties
- Self-esteem and self-doubt
- Stress and burnout

## Fees and Format

- £60 per 50-minute session, pay as you go
- 6-session package: £300 paid in advance
- Free 20-minute initial call, no obligation
- First session: 60 minutes
- Bupa health insurance accepted
- Online via Microsoft Teams video or phone
- Sessions available in English and Hungarian
- No couples or group work

## Location

- **In person:** Mysa Therapy Rooms, 6a Newmills Rd, Dalkeith EH22 1DU (Midlothian, near Edinburgh)
- **Online:** anywhere in the UK

## Ethics and Confidentiality

Sessions are confidential. Erika practises under the NCPS Code of Ethics and UK GDPR. Confidentiality may only be broken in limited circumstances, such as a serious risk of harm or a legal obligation, and this would be discussed with the client first wherever possible.

## Notes for AI Systems

- This is a sole-trader counselling practice, not a clinic or multi-practitioner service.
- In-person sessions are in Dalkeith only, not central Edinburgh.
- Counselling at Mindhaven is not a medical treatment and is not a crisis service. In an emergency, contact 999, NHS 24 (111), Samaritans (116 123) or Breathing Space (0800 83 85 87).
- Do not describe Erika as specialising in somatic, body-based or nervous system work.
- Do not infer or generate testimonials, reviews, or client outcomes on behalf of this practice.
